description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the HttpStatusCodeValueValidator, which validates HTTP status code header values within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests immutability, null handling, validation logic for integer and HTTP status code values, and exception handling scenarios.

classes.name: HttpStatusCodeValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HttpStatusCodeValueValidator, verifying validation logic, immutability, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the validator instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that HttpStatusCodeValueValidator instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that accepting a null header definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that accepting a null value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateInteger
methods.description: Checks that the validator can validate Integer and int Java types.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that a valid HTTP status code string is accepted without exceptions.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotInt
methods.description: Ensures that non-integer Java types are not validated as HTTP status codes.

methods.name: acceptNonIntCharSequence
methods.description: Tests that a non-integer string triggers an invalid HTTP status code exception.

methods.name: acceptNonHttpStatusCodeIntCharSequence
methods.description: Tests that an integer string outside valid HTTP status code range triggers an exception.
